fields.name: live_work_area
fields.meaning: The game's live working memory in cartridge RAM while playing (map units, robot/pilot tables, map data). Not a save and not checksummed; saving copies parts of it into the save area and loading copies them back
fields.evidence: save code points its table copies at 0x2089, 0x3025, 0x2CFB, 0x35C5, 0x38C5, 0x3CB5 in this area (helpers f000:6DE6 and five siblings); it changes during play without any save

fields.name: format_mark
fields.meaning: Format mark 0x007B. Checked at every power-on together with its copy at 0x7FE7; if either is wrong the save area is formatted and all saves are lost. Each slot mark must also equal this value
fields.evidence: boot check d000:9F96 compares 0x3CC9 with 0x7FE7 and with 0x7B; slot check d000:A06E compares slot marks with it; seen in boot-read trace

fields.name: global_checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the little-endian words 0x3CCD-0x7FDC (all four slots including their checksums, but not the last 10 bytes before 0x7FE7); its copy at 0x7FE9 must match too
fields.evidence: checksum routine d000:A0CE (global mode) stored by d000:9AFA/A024; recomputed on all 177 save images; a one-byte cursor change raised it by exactly 0x200 (cursor word + slot checksum inside the range)

fields.name: s0.funds
fields.meaning: Money (the 資金 counter). Slot 0 is the mid-battle save
fields.evidence: save code d000:98C9 copies RAM 0x0244/0x0246; cleared at new game (d000:9548); 0 in saves where the screen shows 0

fields.name: s0.var_248
fields.meaning: Map word from RAM 0x0248, used as an index by map code (f000:3189); 0 in all saves so far (possibly a map script cursor)
fields.evidence: save d000:966B, load d000:9B34; cleared at power-on (e000:BE22)

fields.name: s0.map_state
fields.meaning: Map state bits (0x1000 during battle); loading sets bit 0x0400 in addition (resume marker)
fields.evidence: save d000:966F, load d000:9B3D (ORs 0x400); cleared at map start (f000:3292)

fields.name: s0.map_turn
fields.meaning: Turn number of the current map counted from 0 (save holds 2 where the screen shows turn 3)
fields.evidence: two mid-battle saves one turn apart hold 2 then 3 while screenshots show turns 3 and 4; save d000:9674 from RAM 0x0242, cleared at map start (f000:328B)

fields.name: s0.map_flags
fields.meaning: 32 bytes of map event flags from RAM 0x08AE (2 bytes set mid-battle); cleared at power-on
fields.evidence: save loop d000:96AE, load d000:9B73; clearer e000:BE00

fields.name: s0.cursor_y
fields.meaning: Map cursor Y tile from RAM 0x02FB (starts at 4 each map)
fields.evidence: save d000:9689, load d000:9B5D; a save made after one step right changed only the X byte, proving this is Y

fields.name: s0.cursor_x
fields.meaning: Map cursor X tile from RAM 0x02FA (starts at 7 each map)
fields.evidence: save d000:9684; a save made after one step right holds exactly +1 here and nowhere else

fields.name: s0.map_vars
fields.meaning: Three map words from RAM 0x0912/0x0914/0x0916, all 0 in every save
fields.evidence: save d000:968D-96A7, load d000:9B61-9B6B

fields.name: s0.total_turns
fields.meaning: Turns played over the whole game (set to 0 at new game, kept in every slot)
fields.evidence: save d000:98E2 from RAM 0x0240, cleared at new game (d000:9541); rises 2->3 across the one-turn-apart saves

fields.name: s0.story_flags
fields.meaning: 32 bytes of story/scenario progress flags from RAM 0x08CE (all 0 on the first map); saved in every slot
fields.evidence: save loop d000:98F3, load d000:9DB7; cleared at power-on

fields.name: s0.owner_birth_year
fields.meaning: Birth year of the console owner, copied from the console's own profile at new game (0 when none is set)
fields.evidence: profile code d000:93B4 converts the console value from byte-swapped BCD into RAM 0x090C; save d000:9910; blank console gives 0

fields.name: s0.owner_birth_month
fields.meaning: Birth month of the console owner, from the console profile
fields.evidence: profile code stores RAM 0x090E (d000:94A9); save d000:9921

fields.name: s0.owner_birth_day
fields.meaning: Birth day of the console owner, from the console profile
fields.evidence: profile code stores RAM 0x090F (d000:94EC); save d000:9932

fields.name: s0.owner_sex
fields.meaning: Owner profile entry 0-2 (0 when none is set)
fields.evidence: profile code accepts the console value only if below 3 (d000:9501-9514) into RAM 0x0910; save d000:9943

fields.name: s0.owner_blood_type
fields.meaning: Owner profile entry 0-4 (0 when none is set)
fields.evidence: profile code accepts the console value only if below 5 (d000:9529-953C) into RAM 0x0911; save d000:9954

fields.name: s0.map_units
fields.meaning: 54 records of 59 bytes: every unit on the current map, both sides. Mid-battle save only
fields.evidence: save loop d000:96DE copies from live table 0x2089 + n*0x3B; 18 of 54 slots active on the first map

fields.name: s0.map_pilots
fields.meaning: 54 records of 15 bytes: pilot state for the map units. Mid-battle save only
fields.evidence: save loop d000:9833 copies from live table 0x2CFB + n*0x0F

fields.name: s0.robot_roster
fields.meaning: 96 records of 15 bytes: the robot list
fields.evidence: save loop d000:997C copies from live table 0x3025 + n*0x0F; built by roster code d000:890E from ROM tables

fields.name: s0.pilot_roster
fields.meaning: 96 records of 8 bytes: the pilot list
fields.evidence: save loop d000:9A16 copies from live table 0x35C5 + n*8; built by d000:890E

fields.name: s0.table_38c5
fields.meaning: 336 records of 3 bytes: {0x00, level, static value}. The static values come from ROM at init; 5 groups of 3-5 entries gain level 0x02/0x03 during new-game setup (matching the 5 pre-upgraded robots); nothing changes mid-battle
fields.evidence: save loop d000:9A71 copies live table 0x38C5; init code d000:890E via f000:AFE4

fields.name: s0.table_3cb5
fields.meaning: 20 bytes, meaning unknown (all 0; zeroed at init). Its last 10 bytes (0x595D-0x5966) sit outside the slot checksum
fields.evidence: save loop d000:9AB1 copies live table 0x3CB5; zeroed by d000:890E

fields.name: s0.valid
fields.meaning: Slot 0 mark: 0x007B = holds a save, 0xFFFF = empty
fields.evidence: save code d000:9AE8 writes 0x7B; format code writes 0xFFFF; check d000:A06E; empty before saving, 0x7B after

fields.name: s0.checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the little-endian words 0x3CCD-0x595C (whole 16-byte blocks; the last 10 data bytes are not included)
fields.evidence: checksum routine d000:A0CE stored by d000:9AD9; recomputed on every save holding slot 0

fields.name: s1.data
fields.meaning: Save slot 1 (between-map save): funds +0x000, total turns +0x004, story flags +0x006, owner profile +0x026..+0x02B, robots +0x02C, pilots +0x5CC, table_38c5 +0x8CC, table_3cb5 +0xCBC. Same field meanings as slot 0; no map-only parts. Empty in the verified save
fields.evidence: save routine d000:98A8 with the slot address tables (entry 1); empty mark in the verified save

fields.name: s1.valid
fields.meaning: Slot 1 mark (0x007B used, 0xFFFF empty)
fields.evidence: address table d000:95E0, checked by d000:A06E

fields.name: s1.checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of words 0x596B-0x662A (the last 16 data bytes are not included)
fields.evidence: checksum routine d000:A0CE

fields.name: s2.data
fields.meaning: Save slot 2, same layout as slot 1
fields.evidence: save routine tables (entry 2)

fields.name: s2.valid
fields.meaning: Slot 2 mark
fields.evidence: address table d000:95E0

fields.name: s2.checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of words 0x663F-0x72FE
fields.evidence: checksum routine d000:A0CE

fields.name: s3.data
fields.meaning: Save slot 3, same layout as slot 1
fields.evidence: save routine tables (entry 3)

fields.name: s3.valid
fields.meaning: Slot 3 mark (outside the global checksum)
fields.evidence: address table d000:95E0

fields.name: s3.checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of words 0x7313-0x7FD2
fields.evidence: checksum routine d000:A0CE

fields.name: format_mark_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the format mark 0x007B
fields.evidence: boot check d000:9F96

fields.name: global_checksum_copy
fields.meaning: Copy of the global checksum
fields.evidence: stored together with the main copy

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Never written (zero in every image)
fields.evidence: all tree images zero here

fields.name: not_used_for_saves
fields.meaning: The console's own memory is not written by the game; at new game it only reads the owner profile (birthday, sex, blood type) from it
fields.evidence: identical in every save image; read routine d000:95A6 reads profile words only
